# Instructions for accurately documenting failed building fire-safety checks

1. Start with the inspection records.
2.
completion:
Include as much work, details and drawing details as possible to support the record of the check.
3. Request details of drawings from the designer to support the review of the design if they have not been provided.
4. Take photos of the building during the inspection to check against drawings.
5. Include photos, extracts from documents, extracts from calculations if available.
6. Fill out the documentation as fully as possible, and use text not dialogue.
7. Ensure other practitioners are named in clarifications, connections to other disciplines.
8. Ensure supporting documents are attached.
9. Check that controls have been taken do in and date stamps are added to meet the data requirements.

# Tools to use and actions to take

1. Prepare a pro forma to be used by the practitioners to document the check, which should include standardisation of content, workflow and sign-off process.
